Definition: Unweighted arithmetic mean of 15 reported mean social-group sizes around Frankfurt, Germany (rural, suburban and urban). Individual site means and coordinates are retained in the snapshot; underlying group sample sizes are unavailable, so this is not a group-weighted species mean. Re-reported by the originating study team in Table 1 (2016), explicitly citing Ziege et al. 2015 DOI 10.1111/jzo.12207; count the team only once. Behavioral observations plus burrow censuses using ferrets; age restriction unspecified.
